title: Indian Standard Specification / Test Method (IS IS_10135)
clause_1_scope: 1.1 This code prescribes general requirements and methods of drainage in and around a gravity dam, its foundations and abutments. It does not cover drainage requirements for energy dissipation devices, chutes and training walls. It may be supplemented by specific requirements to suit the site conditions.

clause_2_normative_references.title: Coarse and Fine Aggregate for Concrete - Specification

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
